content_html:
Cusco, the ancient capital of the Inca Empire, is one of the most visited destinations in South America. To explore its archaeological sites, museums and natural wonders, there is a key tool that every traveler should know: the Cusco Tourist Ticket.

In this quick guide, we explain what it is, what it includes and how to make the most of it on your trip through the heart of Peru.

What is the Cusco Tourist Ticket?

The Cusco Tourist Ticket (BTC) It is an official pass that allows you to enter multiple cultural and archaeological attractions in the city of Cusco and its surroundings. It is an efficient and economical way to get to know the best of the Sacred Valley of the Incas.

What places does it include?

The ticket has several versions. Here we leave you a summary of the comprehensive ticket, which includes up to 16 tourist sites:

  • In Cusco: Sacsayhuamán, Qenqo, Pukapukara, Tambomachay, Museum of Contemporary Art, Regional Historical Museum, among others.
  • In the Sacred Valley: Pisac, Ollantaytambo, Chinchero, Moray.
  • Southern area of Cusco: Tipón, Piquillacta.

These sites represent centuries of history, Inca architecture and living traditions.

Prices and ticket types (2025)

  • Comprehensive ticket (valid for 10 days):
    • Foreign tourists: approx. S/130 (~35 USD)
    • National tourists: approx. S/70 (~18 USD)
  • Partial ticket (valid for 1-2 days, depending on the circuit):
    • Foreigners: S/70 (~18 USD)
    • Nationals: S/40 (~10 USD)

Tip: If you plan to visit more than 3 sites, the comprehensive ticket is the best option.

Where to buy it?

You can purchase your ticket at:

  • The Directorate of Culture Cusco (Av. El Sol 103).
  • Some of the tourist sites included.
  • Authorized travel agencies. You can count on us at GT PERU TRAVEL

Important:The ticket Does not include Machu Picchu, since it has its own entrance and regulation.

Tips for using it

  • Always carry your passport or identification document.
  • Don't lose your ticket: it is non-refundable and non-replaceable.
  • Plan your route according to validity (1 day, 2 days or 10 days).

Ready for your adventure in Cusco?

The Cusco Tourist Ticket is your gateway to an experience rich in culture, history and unforgettable landscapes. Whether you're traveling alone, as a couple, or in a group, this tool helps you get to the essentials without complications.

Explore, discover and live Cusco to the fullest. Your next adventure starts with a ticket.
